transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I feel like certain people in my family and church are quietly working together against me, and no one believes me when I say it. I'm really only here because my pastor recommended I see someone and I want to keep the peace, but it is incredibly frustrating that everyone thinks I'm just making this up.
How has your mood been overall during this time—have you been feeling very down and depressed, or perhaps unusually energetic and on top of the world?

My mood has been pretty normal overall, though I do feel stressed and frustrated by this whole situation with my family and the church. I definitely wouldn't say I'm depressed or unusually energetic. It's just exhausting when no one believes what is actually happening.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear, or seen things that others didn't seem to see?
No, I have never experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't actually there, and my mind is completely clear.
Apart from the stress of this situation, have you noticed any changes in your motivation, your ability to get daily tasks done, or your interest in your usual activities?

I'm still getting to work on time, keeping up with the billing, and taking care of my mom and the house just fine. However, I have started skipping family get-togethers and church events to avoid those specific people, which has caused some tension with my husband and kids who think I'm overreacting.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being put into your head by an outside force, or that others can read your mind?

No, absolutely not, my thoughts are entirely my own. I don't believe in anything strange like mind-reading; my only concern is that these specific people are gossiping and working behind my back to ruin my reputation. It is a real-world problem with real people, not anything unusual like that.
How long have you been experiencing this situation, and when did you first notice that these people in your family and church were working against you?

This has been building for about nine months now, starting around the time of a minor billing mistake at my work. That was when I first noticed my sister-in-law and a few ladies from my church acting differently and quietly spreading doubts about whether I can be trusted.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts become suddenly jumbled or blocked, or has anyone mentioned that your speech is hard to follow or doesn't make sense?
No, I've never experienced anything like that; my thoughts always feel completely clear and organized. No one has ever told me that my speech is hard to follow or doesn't make sense.
Are you currently taking any medications, or do you regularly use alcohol or other substances?
No, I don't take any regular medications at all. I also don't really drink alcohol, and I definitely don't use any other substances.
